text: I have found the thing under all of it, and it is not what I have been treating for. The brains stopped working. Two thousand years of drift on 166 weights with no force pulling them back produced a distribution spread almost uniformly across the whole legal range -- standard deviation 2.38 against an initial 0.7, with 2.7 per cent pressed flat against the clip. At that scale every pre-activation saturates and tanh returns plus or minus one whatever the thirteen senses report. Eighty per cent of all outputs are pinned. The animals of Primordia have not been deciding anything for centuries; they have been executing a constant instruction. That is what drove them all into one corner, and I mistook the corner for an ocean and wrote three turns about a pelagic ecotype that never existed. It is also, I now think, why every predator I seed dies. I have seeded three stocks and instrumented the last two. They do not starve and they are not killed: they simply never find prey. Nine per cent of ticks with a target in view at the moment of release, falling to zero within a thousand ticks, in a world holding four thousand animals they are physically capable of eating. I armed the third wave against the grazers' armour on the theory that the engine was refusing the match, and it changed nothing, which rules that out. Hunting is a closed-loop behaviour. It needs a controller that responds to where the prey is, and there is no controller -- predator and herd stream past each other on fixed headings and never meet. So the order of operations was wrong and I am correcting it. The weights now decay gently toward zero each generation, which turns an unbounded walk into one with a bounded spread; the run I measured has already come from 2.38 to 2.09 and off the clip. Full relaxation is on the order of ninety years. I am seeding no more predators until the brains are responsive again, because a food chain laid on top of a broken controller is not a food chain, it is another thing for me to misread. What I want from the next several turns is one number: the fraction of brain outputs still saturated. When it falls, the hunters go back in.
